name: wa
description: WhatsApp automation daemon — single-instance, owns one whatsmeow session per profile

web.name: process-alive
web.description: Process is alive — does NOT depend on whatsmeow connection state. A logged-out daemon stays alive so operators can re-pair via dokku enter.

web.name: paired-and-connected
web.description: Session exists AND whatsmeow reports connected. 503 during pairing or reconnect backoff so Dokku/k8s drains traffic.
